Synchronize Objective-C EMAPI connection reads and preserve pending response/report routing.

Synchronize Objective-C EMAPI connection reads and preserve pending response/report routing.

Details:
- Added an NSCondition-backed shared read path for EMAPISession so decoded commands enter pendingCommands under one lock.
- Changed report reads to scan pending reports first and wait when only ordinary responses are pending.
- Added Objective-C XCTest coverage for concurrent report reads with command responses and pending response preservation.

Validation:
- git diff --check passed.
- xcodebuild test -project objectivec/fruits/emapi/emapi.xcodeproj -scheme emapi -configuration Debug could not run because xcodebuild is not installed in this Linux lane.
